files.content:
# Pixel Lights-Out Puzzle

A classic 3x3 Lights-Out puzzle game built with HTML, CSS, and plain JavaScript. No external dependencies, works offline.

## How to Play

- Click any cell to toggle it and its orthogonal neighbors (up, down, left, right).
- The goal is to turn all lights off.
- Your move count is tracked.
- When all lights are off, a win message appears.
- Click **New Puzzle** to generate a new random solvable puzzle.

## Features

- 3x3 grid with toggle logic
- Move counter
- Win detection and message
- New Puzzle button (generates solvable puzzle)
- Keyboard accessible (Tab to navigate, Enter/Space to activate)
- Responsive design (works from 360px wide)
- ARIA live regions for move count and win message

## Running

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No server or build step required.

## Files

- `index.html` – main page structure
- `style.css` – styling and layout
- `script.js` – game logic

## Controls

- **Mouse/Touch**: Click or tap a cell to toggle.
- **Keyboard**: Tab to focus a cell, press Enter or Space to toggle. Tab to the New Puzzle button and press Enter/Space to restart.
